response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS average_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS f JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT site_code, access_status, average_traitcount, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS record_share FROM grouped ORDER BY record_share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Passing the 489 threshold means traitcount is greater than 489.

alternatives.interpretation: If passing the threshold includes 489, use traitcount >= 489.
